name: Karen people
description: Three horizontal stripes of red, white and blue with a red canton bearing a rising sun and a Karen frog drum in gold.
history: The Karen national flag was adopted in 1937 by the Karen National Association and is used by Karen communities and organizations in Myanmar, Thailand and the diaspora. The rising sun signals the dawn of the nation; the bronze frog drum is the Karens' ancient cultural emblem. The flag of Myanmar's Kayin State is a distinct, later design.
